_comment: Publishing boundary. Everything under issues/ that is NOT listed in `examples` is PRIVATE_SOURCE. Keep this list identical to the allow-list in the repository .gitignore (a test enforces it).

classes.PRIVATE_SOURCE: unpublished manuscripts, photos, captions, notes, editorial data, reviews of a real issue — never commit to a public/Pages repository
classes.GENERATED_PRIVATE: PDF, metrics, preflight, rhythm, fingerprint… derived from private source
classes.PUBLISHABLE: example issues listed above, publish/<id>/ (deliberately released files), the public site
classes.SYSTEM: framework code, themes, layouts, schemas, tests, docs, review records of the framework
